definitions.gloss: auspicious; lucky; of good omen; bringing good fortune
definitions.explanation: Describing something that is considered a sign of good luck or that brings favorable outcomes. Deeply rooted in Japanese folk beliefs about omens and fortune.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鶴|つる}→鶴：04359_tsuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{亀|かめ}→亀：02198_kame⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{縁起|えんぎ}が{良|い}い⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Cranes and turtles are considered to bring good luck.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{縁起|えんぎ}→縁起：13815_engi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{良|い}い⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧だ。
examples.english: It is a Japanese custom to eat auspicious foods at New Year.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦{縁起|えんぎ}→縁起：13815_engi⟧ refers to omens or signs of fortune, and {縁起|えんぎ}が{良|い}い means something is a good omen. Often used in the context of traditional Japanese customs, especially around New Year, weddings, and other celebrations. The opposite is ⟦{縁起|えんぎ}→縁起：13815_engi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (unlucky, of bad omen).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{縁起|えんぎ}→縁起：13815_engi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{良|い}い⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧ (lucky number)
- ⟦{縁起|えんぎ}→縁起：13815_engi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{良|い}い⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧ (auspicious food)
- ⟦{縁起|えんぎ}→縁起：13815_engi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担|かつ}ぐ→担ぐ：03917_katsugu⟧ (to be superstitious about omens)
- ⟦{縁起物|えんぎもの}→縁起物：15731_engimono⟧ (lucky charm)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{縁起|えんぎ}→縁起：13815_engi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: unlucky, of bad omen — the direct opposite
- ⟦{幸運|こううん}→幸運：02725_kouun⟧: good fortune — more about actual luck than omens
- ⟦{吉|きち}→吉：19344_kichi⟧: good luck, auspiciousness — used in fortune-telling contexts
